_comment: Last-resort Smart Brain connection for a clone with NO environment at all. It ships EMPTY on purpose: the hosted project ref that used to be pinned here paused and every reader kept dialling it, and a checked-in constant that must track an external resource drifts again (this was the third baked-in ref in the repo's history). Configuration is SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (or SMART_BRAIN_SUPABASE_URL / SMART_BRAIN_SUPABASE_KEY) on the deployment, hosted or self-hosted alike; every reader (api/public-config.js, api/_shared/brain-core.js, api/_shared/os-backbone.js, lib/smart-brain/services.js) consults the env before this file.
